scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run build -w @vidpulse/db && npm run build -w @vidpulse/kpop-sources && npm run build -w @vidpulse/parser && npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run build -w @vidpulse/db && npm run build -w @vidpulse/kpop-sources && npm run build -w @vidpulse/parser && npm run build -w @vidpulse/monitor && npm run build -w @vidpulse/cli && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.migrate: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run migrate -w @vidpulse/db
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run seed -w @vidpulse/db
scripts.config:migrate: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run config:migrate -w @vidpulse/cli
scripts.config:import-env: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run config:import-env -w @vidpulse/cli
scripts.backfill:video-entities: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run build -w @vidpulse/db && npm run backfill:video-entities -w @vidpulse/cli
scripts.backfill:shorts-tags: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run build -w @vidpulse/db && npm run backfill:shorts-tags -w @vidpulse/cli
scripts.merge:short-tags: npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run build -w @vidpulse/db && npm run merge:short-tags -w @vidpulse/cli
scripts.launch: concurrently -n BE,FE -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:all:once: npm install && npm run build -w @vidpulse/config && npm run build -w @vidpulse/db && npm run build -w @vidpulse/kpop-sources && npm run build -w @vidpulse/parser && npm run build -w @vidpulse/monitor && npm run build -w @vidpulse/cli && npm run migrate -w @vidpulse/db && npm run launch
